topics.label: Introduction and lecture overview on cancer hallmarks
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining the learning objectives and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and proliferative deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how mutations in cell-surface receptors and downstream intracellular cascades deregulate growth signals to sustain cancer cell proliferation and survival.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells fail to withdraw from the cell cycle and complete normal terminal differentiation in both hematopoietic malignancies and colorectal carcinoma.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis and p53 tumor suppression
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through alterations in p53 signaling and the balance between pro- and anti-apoptotic proteins.

topics.label: Telomere regulation, replicative senescence, and stress-response pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics cover the mechanisms of telomere shortening, TERT reactivation for replicative immortality, and p53-dependent stress checkpoints that induce senescence and arrest.

topics.label: Altered cellular metabolism and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe metabolic rewiring in cancer cells, including aerobic glycolysis (the Warburg effect) and the epigenetic impacts of metabolic gene mutations.

topics.label: Induction of tumor angiogenesis
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how expanding tumors stimulate new blood vessel growth to supply oxygen and nutrients past diffusion limits.

topics.label: Mechanisms and biology of cancer metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the systemic dissemination cascade of metastatic cells, the seed-and-soil hypothesis, and genomic analyses of metastatic clones.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a summary of the hallmarks framework, recommended literature, and closing remarks.
